hypothesis: On the registered size-3 EML pair, blind GD over every size-3 skeleton still recovers the fat zero target from more skeletons than the thin singleton. If the skeleton counts are equal, reject Φ-predicts-unknown-skeleton-GD at this bound.

controls.description: Unweighted exact hits must stay 2 vs 1. That is the Gibbs control, not the headline.
Every labeled size-3 tree is tried, not only the known matching formulas.
GD from a small perturbation of the all-ones weights on the true zero skeleton must succeed, or withhold.
The process is GD on skeletons, not a Gibbs draw from the census.

gates.criterion: The size-3 census has 80 trees and both targets have min_internal=3.
Exact unweighted hits are 2 for zero and 1 for thin.
The run discloses that recovery is GD on every skeleton.
At least one perturbed-correct trial on the true zero skeleton succeeds.
The ranking is recorded and is not withheld_optimizer.
The run does not claim the neural bootstrap.
